chunks: From him, from Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Yaqteen, from his brother Al-Husayn, from Ali ibn Yaqteen, who said:

I asked Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) about the supererogatory prayer that is prayed on Friday at the time of the obligatory prayer, before the Friday prayer: is it better or after it? He said, 'Before the prayer.'
ai.seo_question: When is the best time to pray the Friday supererogatory prayer, before or after the main Friday prayer?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) establishes the precedence of the pre-congregational Friday nafl prayer, a ruling that underscores the importance of individual devotion preceding communal worship. This preference aligns with the broader Shia jurisprudential emphasis on maximizing spiritual merit through timely supererogatory acts, reflecting the Prophet's practice of offering voluntary prayers before the main assembly. The hadith serves as a practical guideline for believers to structure their Friday worship, ensuring that personal piety complements the collective ritual.
